description: The LOCAL compact-certificate deployment of check_signal_service_local_signup.py --compact --manifest (the second server instance, scripts/start_compact_server.sh: embedSigner false, 138-byte certificates naming libsignal's test signer 0x7357C357 by id): production's shapes as far as the local server can show them. Its terminator (scripts/coalesced_terminator.py) gives production's handshake shape: the encrypted flight in ONE record (621 bytes here, measure_handshake.py local-compact; 1122 at chat.signal.org), one Ed25519 certificate, 16 bytes of record padding. libsignal profile (official padding, signal-seal-official), the signup layouts official clients send (ciphertext 176 for the legacy test layout, 240 for Signal-Android's), both content hints. Contacts with up to 4 devices (2026-11-12, after the first real run met a contact with three: 409, device refresh): bundle_slots 1 (bundle-slot reads an item of any digit counts, TlsMpc/BundleSlotKernels.lean), device_lists pending (a device list holds only devices that have not answered: 2^n request frames for n devices), record_max 12288 for the prekey response of four devices (about 10.4 KB), opened with tls-open-typed only above scan_record_max 10240 (the framing-scan kernels of 12288 do not lower under the 16 GB cap; they run only on small handshake records). tls-open-typed 12288 itself peaks at 23.6 GB when produced (4.58M AND gates, 59 s): produce this deployment with --max-gb 26. signup_jump 3: the launchers set SIGNAL_RECEIVE_JUMP=3 (a first message may be the sender's number 0 to 3, as production's). See handshake_backend/EmpHybridWork/CIRCUIT_SHAPES.md for each setting.
